resources.string:
Finance Tracker builds your expense list from the transaction alerts your bank sends by SMS.

• Only messages from known bank senders are read. All other messages are ignored.
• Your messages stay on this phone. Nothing is uploaded.
Without SMS access, Finance Tracker can\'t find your bank alerts.\n\nOnly messages from known bank senders are read, and they never leave this phone.
To allow it, open Settings, tap Permissions, then SMS, and choose Allow.\n\nOnly messages from known bank senders are read, and they never leave this phone.
No transactions yet.\n\nWhen your bank sends a transaction alert, tap Rescan to add it.
SMS access is off, so nothing was scanned.
